judgment.reason: Candidate describes nature/purpose but misstates that activities 'primarily involve response to Russia-Ukraine conflict and continued integration of Bemis' for Q2 FY2023 close; evidence says Q2 FY2023 (Dec 31 2022) activities primarily comprised Russia-Ukraine, while Bemis integration was substantially completed end FY2022 and was FY2021 activity. Also reference states 87% employee-related; candidate gives breakdown but does not state 87% employee liability proportion. Substantive answer provided but contains period/scope error vs evidence.
